answered.sql: SELECT responsibility FROM Responsibilities WHERE id IN (SELECT responsibilityId FROM Internships_Responsibilities WHERE internshipId IN (SELECT id FROM Internships)) GROUP BY responsibility HAVING COUNT(responsibilityId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Internships)

candidates.meaning: Return a list of responsibilities associated with each internship.
candidates.sql: SELECT I.title, R.responsibility FROM Internships I JOIN Internships_Responsibilities IR ON I.id = IR.internshipId JOIN Responsibilities R ON IR.responsibilityId = R.id

candidates.meaning: List the responsibilities associated with each internship.
candidates.sql: SELECT I.title, R.responsibility FROM Internships I JOIN Internships_Responsibilities IR ON I.id = IR.internshipId JOIN Responsibilities R ON R.id = IR.responsibilityId

candidates.meaning: Identify the primary responsibility for each internship.
candidates.sql: SELECT I.title, R.responsibility FROM Internships I JOIN Internships_Responsibilities IR ON I.id = IR.internshipId JOIN Responsibilities R ON R.id = IR.responsibilityId GROUP BY I.title, R.responsibility ORDER BY I.title, R.responsibility

candidates.meaning: Provide a summary of responsibilities for each internship, listing all associated responsibilities.
candidates.sql: SELECT I.title, GROUP_CONCAT(R.responsibility) AS responsibilities FROM Internships I JOIN Internships_Responsibilities IR ON I.id = IR.internshipId JOIN Responsibilities R ON R.id = IR.responsibilityId GROUP BY I.title

candidates.meaning: Which specific responsibilities are associated with each internship?
candidates.sql: SELECT I.title, R.responsibility FROM Internships I JOIN Internships_Responsibilities IR ON I.id = IR.internshipId JOIN Responsibilities R ON IR.responsibilityId = R.id

candidates.meaning: Which shared responsibility is common among all internships?
candidates.sql: SELECT R.responsibility FROM Responsibilities R JOIN Internships_Responsibilities IR ON R.id = IR.responsibilityId GROUP BY R.responsibility HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT IR.internshipId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Internships)

candidates.meaning: Which responsibilities are associated with each internship, considering the shared responsibility among all internships?
